repos.description: 🐱 BongoCat — A cross-platform interactive desktop pet that brings fun to your desktop!
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

repos.description: 🐱 🧸跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，支持Windows、macOS和Linux。猫咪会在桌面上自由行走、互动，为桌面增添趣味与陪伴感。项目正从Tauri迁移至C/C++、SDL3和OpenGL的原生实现，轻量高效，适合个性化桌面装饰与解压场景。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet app supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The cat wanders and interacts on your desktop, adding fun and companionship. Migrating from Tauri to a native C/C++ + SDL3 + OpenGL implementation for better performance, ideal for desktop personalization and stress relief.

repos.description: CAT 作为服务端项目基础组件，提供了 Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go 等多语言客户端，已经在美团点评的基础架构中间件框架（MVC框架，RPC框架，数据库框架，缓存框架等，消息队列，配置系统等）深度集成，为美团点评各业务线提供系统丰富的性能指标、健康状况、实时告警等。
repos.summary_zh: CAT 是美团点评开源的实时应用监控平台，支持 Java、C/C++、Node.js、Python、Go 等多语言客户端，提供 Transaction、Event、Heartbeat、Metric 四种监控模型。其核心优势在于秒级实时数据处理、全量数据采集、高可用部署及高吞吐扩展能力，广泛应用于服务端性能监控、故障定位与业务优化。
repos.summary_en: CAT is a real-time application monitoring platform developed by Meituan-Dianping, offering multi-language clients (Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go) and supporting four monitoring models: Transaction, Event, Heartbeat, and Metric. It excels in sub-minute real-time processing, full-data collection, high availability, and scalable distributed deployment, enabling comprehensive performance tracking, fault detection, and system optimization across enterprise infrastructure.

repos.description: Story-first Agent Skill for creating, routing, and QA-checking PPT, HTML, and image-first presentation decks
repos.summary_zh: Knowledge Cat PPT Skill 是一款专为 AI 智能体（如 Codex、Claude Code）设计的演示文稿生产系统。它采用“故事优先”理念，通过受众分析、叙事构建和多通道路由（原生可编辑 PPTX、HTML 演示、图像优先 PPTX），将零散素材转化为结构化演示。系统集成了严格的 JSON 与 HTML 校验器、证据追踪机制及 44 种风格模板库，确保从大纲规划到最终渲染 QA 的全流程专业性与高可用性。
repos.summary_en: Knowledge Cat PPT Skill is a story-first presentation production system for AI agents like Codex and Claude Code. It transforms rough ideas into structured decks through audience analysis, narrative planning, and multi-lane routing (Native PPTX, HTML, Image-first). Featuring strict validators, evidence tracking, and a 44-style template library, it ensures professional quality from planning to rendered QA.
